title: Skid Row Sequences
eyebrow: GPOM chorus 1 · Skid Row Britain · round 1
heading: Four ways to cut the drop
intro: Each video starts with 4 seconds of black and the song building, which is where the intro's zoom into black leaves us. Then the drop: the 32 beats (11 s) of chorus 1, cut on the beat, with all your 12 clips. Pick the one closest to right; it becomes the starting layout of your hand-cut workbench in Premiere, with every clip in a bin beside it. Mixes are welcome as a note, e.g. 'A but open like B'.

groups.title: Sequence
groups.line: My pick: A. It is Outbreak Night's grammar: two-beat cuts across the whole country on the drop, then it holds on Hyde Park's shanty city with the lit towers behind (who gained), straight into the banks emptying.

opts.label: A · Two-beat cuts, then hold on the towers: motorway, queue, station, tower block, seaside, the fence, the data centre, Glasgow, Primrose Hill, faces, then Hyde Park held
B · Outward: opens on two faces at the brazier, ends rising over the motorway town
C · Cost and machine: every other shot is the machines still working (the warehouse, the data centre, the towers)
D · Long takes: six shots of five or six beats, each allowed to land
